thread:
Ana (Partnerships): Quick sync — NovaWeights launch checklist. They signed the MOU but legal flagged redistribution language for quantized weights and hardware-bundled SKUs. Can we align on final asks by EOW? @Mike @Sarah
Mike (Legal): I reviewed the MOU. Primary concerns: export control classification, attribution, and a clause preventing standalone resale of redistributed quantized weights. Draft suggestion: \"Licensee may distribute quantized or derivative weights only as part of an authorized hardware appliance; standalone redistribution is prohibited unless explicitly licensed.\" Thoughts?
Sarah (Product): For the marketplace SKU we need: model-card, manifest (version/hash), recommended inference flavors (float32 / 8-bit / 4-bit), and a minimum test-suite. Also need an explicit field for supported inference APIs.
Lee (Engineering): We can produce three artifacts: float32, 8-bit, 4-bit. Note: 4-bit will likely show quality delta in some prompts — we should include a short caveat in the model-card. Also will deliver a small benchmark table (latency / throughput / mem) per artifact.
Jordan (Solutions): SI partners will want a ref-arch and terraform examples. Suggest a 6-week field trial with one SI before broad SI enablement. We should pick an SI partner to pilot — recommends BrightWave.
Ana (Partnerships): Proposed timeline: legal sign-off by Thu, artifact packaging Wed, SI pilot starts next Mon, embargo & joint announcement week after next. Can people confirm blockers?
Mike (Legal): Blocker: NovaWeights asked for a clause that allows redistribution to \"channel partners\" named in Schedule A. We need clarity: is the list static or dynamic? If dynamic, what approval gate?
Sarah (Product): Compromise: allow redistribution to named channel partners in Schedule A plus any SI partners with a signed addendum. All additional channel partners require mutual written approval. That keeps control while being pragmatic.
Lee (Engineering): Also requirement from infra/security: baked artifact checksums and a signed provenance file for each artifact. Suggest we add `sha256` in the package manifest, e.g. `sha256:model-v1.tar.gz=ab12...`.
Ana (Partnerships): Marketing needs: logo assets (SVG/PNG), an embargo date, and a one-sentence quote from NovaWeights' CEO for the joint press. Can someone own outreach?
Jordan (Solutions): I'll own the SI playbook (ref-arch + terraform snippet + integration checklist). Need a contact at BrightWave and one small customer for the field trial; will ping them today.
Mike (Legal): I'll scope an export-control appendix and an explicit quantization grant clause. Two questions for NovaWeights: 1) do they want their own brand on the hardware SKU? 2) do quantized weights require a separate export classification?
Ana (Partnerships): Action items (compact):
- Mike: finalize legal text + export appendix by Thu
- Lee: produce artifacts + checksums and benchmark doc by Wed
- Sarah: marketplace manifest + model-card template by Wed
- Jordan: SI playbook + BrightWave outreach by EOD today
- Marketing: collect logos, draft joint social copy, set embargo calendar (assigned to Ana)
Mike (Legal): Quick draft clause for review: 
```
License Grant. Licensor grants Licensee a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to distribute derivative or quantized models only as integrated components of an authorized hardware appliance or in a SaaS offering explicitly listed in Schedule A. Standalone distribution of model weights is prohibited without a separate distribution license.
```
Sarah (Product): That reads OK. Add a short bullet about required attribution and the model-card being included in distributor docs.
Lee (Engineering): Packaging note: we'll put artifacts into a signed tarball with `manifest.json` that includes `version`, `sha256`, `precision`, and `quantization-method`.
Ana (Partnerships): Small PR note — marketing prefers to call the announcement a \"joint availability with NovaWeights and BrightWave\" rather than \"launch\". Need sign-off from NovaWeights marketing too.
Jordan (Solutions): SI outreach: if BrightWave is OK, we'll do a one-customer pilot (6 weeks) then produce an SI enablement kit (playbook + sample terraform + diagnostics).
Mike (Legal): Final point: if NovaWeights insists on an open list of channel partners (wildcard), we should counter with: named partners + annual review + right to revoke distribution rights for compliance reasons.
Ana (Partnerships): Okay — let's aim to close legal and artifact packaging this week. I'll create the editorial calendar for the embargo and ping NovaWeights for the CEO quote.
deploy-bot: Reminder: calendar event created — "NovaWeights joint availability embargo" on 2024-06-10 09:00 UTC (private).
Ana (Partnerships): Thanks all — will update this thread as items move. :thumbsup:
